text: ポケモン　トレーナーの　さがだな　いいだろう！

structure.jp: ポケモン　トレーナーの　さがだな
structure.en: that's a Pokémon Trainer's nature, I guess

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう adds 'I suppose' or 'probably' to what comes before. With いい it is a set way of agreeing from above. いいだろう = 'very well'.

patterns.name: 〜な (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a rougher, mostly male form of ね, used here when thinking something over aloud. さがだな = 'it's their nature, I guess'.
